NOTE
**Still not ready — screenshots not redone, and the PR's own notes show a case still broken**

New: The author says the PR is updated, but there is no new push since the feedback, and the description still has the same long list of before/after images with no clear explanation of what each one shows. Missing: precise before/after screenshots as the guide describes, and a fix for the "collapse, then mute" case, which the PR's own test notes say still stays hidden after clicking "show more".

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and have the author fix that case and redo the screenshots; no reviewer yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! I don't see a new push yet, and the screenshots still don't clearly show one problem and its fix per scenario, as described in [the guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots). Your test notes also say that collapsing a message and then muting the user still doesn't work after clicking "show more", so please fix that and then re-request review.
```
